card.text: M29 is an open star cluster in the Milky Way, about 1,709 parsecs away.

sources.label: Hunt & Reffert (2023), Improving the open cluster census. II. An all-sky cluster catalogue with Gaia DR3, A&A 673, A114; CDS J/A+A/673/A114, Table 3 (clusters), NGC_6913: dist50, the median of the maximum-likelihood distance, 1708.8526597 pc (16th to 84th percentile 1703 to 1715)
Wikipedia, "Messier 29"
sources.quote: Messier 29 or M29, also known as NGC 6913 or the Cooling Tower Cluster, is a quite small, bright open cluster of stars just south of the central bright star Gamma Cygni of a northerly zone of the sky, Cygnus.

introduction.text: M29 is drawn as 57 of its member stars, measured by Gaia; each dot sits at its sky position, at the cluster's distance.
